_readme: Registry of live client sites for automated health checks. Add every site you launch. A site that is not listed here is not being monitored, and nothing will tell you when its form breaks.

_fields.name: Human name, used in alerts.
_fields.url: Live site origin, no trailing slash.
_fields.enabled: Set false to skip without deleting the entry.
_fields.form.endpoint: Path or absolute URL the form POSTs to. Leave null until known: the submission test is then skipped and reported as skipped, never as passing.
_fields.form.payload: A valid minimal submission for this form. Fields must satisfy the endpoint's validation or the test will fail for the wrong reason.
_fields.supabase.table: Table the enquiry should land in. Enables storage verification and the freshness check.
